apps.localizedDescription: Aukkhor English and Bangla keyboard with Windows and TV companions. Contains the main app and one keyboard extension; no Share extension. Unsigned IPA: signer must preserve and provision both bundle IDs.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 53 removes individual live glass effects from all keycaps, retaining the shared/native glass background and customizable translucent key colors. Press feedback now changes only the label/icon opacity. Intended to reduce rendering load following device reports that disabling Glass improved typing. Compiled and passed IPA bundle audits; simulator tests were not rerun for this release and physical-device typing remains unverified. The earlier suggestion test failure remains unresolved.

Press feedback now changes only the label/icon opacity. Intended to reduce rendering load following device reports that disabling Glass improved typing. versions.localizedDescription: Build 52 improves key touch tolerance and disables the glide recognizer entirely when Glide is off. Compilation and app/keyboard IPA audits passed. The preceding build passed 9 native tests, including touch-gap and layout checks; the suggestion-update test failed. Published at the owner's request with that failure unresolved. Physical-device typing remains unverified.
versions.changelog: Adds six-point tolerance around key targets and chooses the nearest enabled key in small gaps. The Glide recognizer is fully disabled when Glide is off. Keeps the seamless native background. Compilation and exact bundle audits passed; 9 of 10 native tests passed in build 51, including the new touch tests. Suggestion-update test failure remains unresolved; end-to-end device typing is not verified.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 50 restores physical key taps while keeping the seamless Background: iOS fix. The decorative glass canvas is now non-interactive, with all keys hosted in a separate transparent layer above it. Compilation, exact app/keyboard bundle audit, and native layout and hit-target tests passed. Physical-device verification remains required. Unsigned IPA includes the main app and one keyboard extension; provision both IDs when signing.
versions.changelog: Touch delivery fix: glass and photo backgrounds are decoration-only and can no longer intercept key presses. All keys, including Space and action keys, now live in a dedicated transparent interaction layer above the native iOS background. Regression coverage verifies the visible key is the actual hit-test target with keycaps present or removed and with the number row off or on. Background: iOS remains seamless and compact; Background: Custom retains glass, tint, and photo controls. Build and IPA metadata audits passed; the native layout and hit-target suite passed. Physical iPhone verification remains pending.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 48 removes duplicate background layers in Background: iOS mode and corrects app/keyboard bundle versions. Compilation and IPA audit passed. Full-screen UI and device verification remain incomplete. Unsigned IPA includes the main app and one keyboard extension; provision both IDs when signing.
versions.changelog: Native background update: transparent input root and no duplicate rounded glass panel in Background: iOS, the default for glass/System themes. Normal and removed keycaps supported; compact height retained. Background: Custom retains separate glass/tint/photo options. Corrected actual app and keyboard bundle metadata to version 0.2.0, build 48, with exact-version IPA audit. Published at the owner's request before full-screen UI verification completed. Physical-device appearance remains unverified; iOS controls margins and globe area outside the extension.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 47 removes Aukkhor's duplicate background layers in Background: iOS mode. Full-screen UI and physical-device verification remain incomplete. Unsigned IPA includes the main app and one keyboard extension; preserve and provision both bundle IDs when signing.
versions.changelog: Native background update: transparent input root and no duplicate rounded glass panel with Background: iOS (default for glass/System themes). Works with normal keycaps and Keycaps: None; retains compact height. Background: Custom keeps separate Clear/Frosted glass, tint and photos. Compiled with Xcode 27.1 and passed host/keyboard IPA audit. Published at the owner's request before full-screen UI verification completed. Physical iPhone appearance remains unverified; iOS controls margins and the globe strip outside the extension.

versions.localizedDescription: Aukkhor English and Bangla keyboard with Windows and TV companions. Contains the main app and one keyboard extension; no Share extension. Unsigned IPA: signer must preserve and provision both bundle IDs.
versions.changelog: Glass rendering correction: adaptive Frosted glass is the default for unset preferences; explicit Clear choices are preserved. Restore the native keyboard backdrop and refresh the canvas material after window presentation. Clear/Frosted controls now refresh the app preview. Retains build 37 compact height and removable keycaps. Eight simulator tests passed, including pixel checks over a black responder host on first opening and reopening; physical-device appearance remains unverified.
